Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 20

“Then, seeing Dhritarashtra's sons arrayed for battle, as the weapons were about to clash, Arjuna, whose banner bore Hanuman, took up his bow and spoke these words to Krishna, O king.”

Arjuna, marked by the emblem of Hanuman on his flag, raises his bow — the moment right before speech, right before the crisis that will unfold across the rest of the chapter.
